snippet.title: Jarnathan's Cleaning Service - Playthrough
snippet.description:
https://andyman404.itch.io/jarnathan
Jarnathan teaches you about cleaning and dealing with life's messes in this feel-good physics-based game. Made in 48 hours for SuperTry Game Jam 2024.

Music: City Lights by HoliznaCC0 (CC0)
